purpose: Create a deterministic private reproduction archive for the repository-only CMLE one-click result while keeping exact ordered-input identity, semantic row-order identity, configuration identity, first-read/result identity, privacy scope, and ZIP transport identity distinct.

archive_scope.transport: deterministic ZIP with sorted entry names, fixed 1980-01-01 timestamps, fixed permissions, and fixed compression settings

conditional_assets.hard_anchors.csv: included when hard anchors are supplied
conditional_assets.structural_coefficients.csv: included when a structural fit returned
conditional_assets.person_results.csv: included when fixed-calibration Person scoring returned

archive_scope.privacy_warning: The archive contains raw response rows and Person/facet identifiers. It is a private controlled-access reproduction artifact, not a de-identified or public-sharing bundle.

identity_contract.ordered_input_sha256: SHA-256 of the canonical full-precision input CSV in received row order; this drives AnalysisIdentity and changes under row permutation.
identity_contract.semantic_input_sha256: SHA-256 of the same canonical rows sorted by every column; it is recorded for equivalence review but does not overwrite ordered identity.
identity_contract.config_sha256: Existing mfrm_app.evidence canonical JSON fingerprint of resolved runner settings, including a normalized hard-anchor asset hash.
identity_contract.result_sha256: SHA-256 over sorted names, lengths, and SHA-256 values of result assets only; elapsed time and transient optimizer timing are excluded.
identity_contract.archive_content_sha256: SHA-256 over sorted names and bytes of every core asset before manifest insertion; the manifest records this non-circular value.
identity_contract.zip_sha256: SHA-256 of deterministic ZIP bytes; it is returned outside the ZIP to avoid a self-referential manifest.
identity_contract.binary64: CSV uses 17 significant digits; decision identity uses raw numeric results and never a displayed rounded value.

success_gates.identity: Every parent SHA-256 matches before execution.
success_gates.determinism: Two builds from each retained result have identical asset hashes, ArchiveContentSHA256, and ZIP SHA-256.
success_gates.round_trip: Every archive verifies, reloads all six bilingual cards, and reconstructs registered terminal status without using Streamlit.
success_gates.replay: Private input/config replay reproduces AnalysisID, result identity, terminal status, card bytes, and every registered result-asset hash for all three cases.
success_gates.row_order: A deterministic input-row permutation preserves SemanticInputSHA256 but changes OrderedInputSHA256 and AnalysisID; the difference is never silently normalized away.
success_gates.anchor_order: Reversing hard-anchor row order preserves the normalized anchor bytes, configuration fingerprint, and AnalysisID.
success_gates.tamper: Changing a result card byte, deleting a declared asset, adding an undeclared asset, or duplicating a ZIP entry is rejected before content is returned.
success_gates.privacy: Any public-mode request fails with an explicit message; README_FIRST and manifest state that raw identifiers are private.
success_gates.floating_point: Raw 17-significant-digit values round-trip; no decision identity is computed from display columns.
success_gates.tests: New archive tests and selected one-click/evidence/export/CMLE tests pass.

interpretation_limits.reproducibility: Deterministic replay on the current engine and platform is not cross-platform bitwise reproducibility.
interpretation_limits.privacy: Private mode is not encryption, access control, anonymization, or institutional sharing approval.
interpretation_limits.semantics: A matching archive hash establishes artifact identity, not model validity, anchor validity, or user comprehension.
